'''Grand Admiral Tsung Beginners Task Force deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Grand Admiral Tsung]]
* '''Published:''' 16 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' Beginners Task Force deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 Beginners Task Force deck Tsung LS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Hey a Death Star II pre-constructed starter deck and a couple o trades and it's time to party!!! Total space war!!!

== Strategy ==

Use Heading for the Medical Frigate to use Superficial Damage, Battle Plan and Squadron Assignments. Then just try to overwhelm...
No big complicated strategy that needs just the right cards at just the right time.
Then make it up as you go along, not the best strategy but it seems to work.
